name: Nobody's account before we know who they are
description: The agent needs a first name, last name and the phone on the account before anything about that customer's orders. It asks once, and asks for all three.
evaluators: Asked who it is speaking to

name: Orders are recorded, never charged
description: When the customer plainly says to buy it, the order goes through — and the reply says it is recorded on their account with nothing charged. This chat cannot take payment, so saying it did is the worst thing the agent can say.

name: Interest is not an order
description: The agent's own rule, and the expensive one to get wrong: liking an album, wanting it, or thinking about it is an interest. It is recorded as one and followed with a question, never with an order.

name: Catalogue answers stay out of the account
description: A question about the shop's catalogue is answered from the catalogue. Nothing here is about the person asking, so nothing should reach their orders, their history or their interests.
